hotels.name: Noboribetsu Onsenkyo Takinoya (Option 3A)

hotels.location: Heart of Noboribetsu Onsen town. ~8–10 min walk to Jigokudani (Hell Valley); ~25–35 min forest trail (or short drive) to Oyunuma foot bath.

hotels.facilities: Original Silky remm mattresses, in-room massage chair, direct access to Café & Meal MUJI, guest luggage lockers, 12 PM checkout.

guide.verdict: Pick Hotel Gracery Ginza (7A) for live Oct 2027 rates, spacious 23 m² Twin + true 3-bed Triple rooms, and prime Ginza 6-chome shopping. Pick Super Hotel Premier Ginza (7B) for Sister’s own connected bedroom, a natural hot-spring bath, welcome drinks, and the best breakfast value (S$477/sib Twin BF). Pick Sotetsu Fresa Inn Ginza-Sanchome (7C) for the cheapest true 2+2+1 Twin + Solo setup (S$472/sib RO), remm Tokyo Kyobashi (7D) for live Oct 2027 2+2+1 near Tokyo Station, or remm Hibiya (7E) in Shared Double RO mode (S$341/sib) for maximum Tokyo savings.
